entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, the leader in performance cycling gear. Please hold for the next available agent.
Yeah, hi. I need to make a return. Just need the label.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, you're speaking with Charlie. I can certainly help you with a return. Do you have your order number handy?
Got it. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the AeroFlow helmet purchased 59 days ago. To make sure I process this correctly for you, what specifically is the issue?
The color is wrong. Doesn't match my gear. The box is unopened, still sealed.
Understood. One moment while I confirm the return eligibility.
It should be fine. Just send the label.
You are absolutely correct. You're well within the 90-day return period. I've just approved the return and the shipping label is on its way to your email now.

Of course. And since having the right gear color is important for visibility and your overall safety on the road, I want to make it easier for you to get the right one. As you're a VIP member, I've added a complimentary expedited shipping credit to your account for your next purchase. You can use that if you decide to reorder the helmet.
Oh. Okay, that's actually helpful. I just got the email with the label. Appreciate the speed. Bye.
You're very welcome. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer. Have a great day!
